items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy and Percy and Milt Jackson and Jeff Davis and Joe Harris, the drummer -- and myself.

ctx.x: And Jimmy was playing alto then.
Yeah, Jimmy was playing the alto. We did a few dates out in California when we did that Savoy thing that they call "Maggie..." You've seen that one; that two-album thing.
